title: Adaptive knob fielding scorecard and routing playbook for enterprise optimization requests
creator: Riley Chen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit optimization requests (batching/caching configuration, quant profiles, routing policies) that require cross-functional handling. Current intake is manual, inconsistent, and often routes requests to engineering that could have been handled by the Optimization Concierge or self-serve guides. Proposal: Build an adaptive triage pipeline that enriches incoming requests, scores them with a Knob Impact Estimator (KIE) and SLA-aware scorecard, and routes to the appropriate lane (Concierge, Self-serve docs + templates, Eng escalation) with recommended SLAs and next steps. The pipeline must be transparent to customers, provide an initial human-readable triage note, and surface the top 3 recommended knob changes and expected cost/latency delta for quick decisioning.
acceptance_criteria: Automated enrichment runs on 100% of new advisory requests and extracts: model family, workload class (high QPS vs low-latency), token distribution sample, and requested outcome (cost reduction, latency, quality).
KIE produces a ranked list of up to 3 knob recommendations with estimated token-cost delta and expected median latency change for the provided workload sample in >= 80% of requests.

SLA-aware scorecard computes an urgency score and suggests routing to one of three lanes: Optimization Concierge (hand-off), Self-serve (docs + template), Engineering Escalation. Automated routing accuracy vs human triage >= 85% in pilot cohort.

Console UI shows triage result, KIE recommendations, and reason strings in the customer request timeline within 30 seconds of submission for hosted customers and within 5 minutes for private/VPC requests (enrichment delay allowances).

Metrics dashboard tracking MTTFR (mean time to first response), percentage auto-resolved by Concierge/self-serve, and eng advisory hours saved is instrumented and reports baseline within rollout week.
success_metrics: Reduce engineering-handled advisory tickets by 40% for signals classified as low-risk optimization
Mean time to first response (MTTFR) <= 24 hours for enterprise requests routed to Concierge
Auto-routing precision >= 85% after first 4 weeks of data
Reduction in customer cost-onboarding time (time from request to validated recommendation) by 30%
runbook_steps: 1) Ingest advisory request into intake queue with payload snapshot and customer tier metadata.

2) Run automated enrichment: infer model family, sequence length distribution, recent throughput patterns (if provided), and annotate whether request references embeddings/streaming/chat/structured output.
3) Execute Knob Impact Estimator (KIE) to simulate knob changes at a high level and output cost/latency deltas and confidence band.
4) Compute SLA-aware scorecard combining customer tier, KIE confidence, requested outcome, and estimated runtime risk to produce urgency score and suggested lane.

5) Auto-route the ticket: Concierge lane (create Concierge task + attach KIE report), Self-serve lane (send templated guidance + invite to self-service test harness), or Engineering lane (create ENG- advisory sub-issue and attach enriched payload).
6) Surface triage summary in customer timeline; add labels and set triage due date per SLA.
7) Monitor feedback loop: if Concierge or Eng updates the ticket, log outcome and feed back into KIE training set for continuous improvement.
comments: 2025-02-12 Riley Chen: Initial draft of the adaptive triage concept. Raised to prioritize enterprise advisory throughput and reduce engineering burnout. Proposed KIE as an ML-backed estimator rather than a rules-only system.
2025-02-18 Maya Thompson: Reviewed with Concierge leads. Requested that the KIE produce a confidence interval and a textual rationale (top features driving the recommendation) for auditability.

2025-02-25 Data Science (Diego Martinez): Feasibility note - we can prototype KIE using a hybrid approach: rule heuristics + small simulated workloads to estimate cost/latency delta. Need sample workload traces from three enterprise customers to validate calibrations.

2025-03-01 Design (Asha Patel): UX requirement - triage summary must be concise and include 'Why this lane' and 'How we estimated impact' collapsible sections. Will prepare two mockups: Concierge-first and Self-serve-first flows.

2025-03-05 PM sync: Agreed to run a 6-week pilot with two high-usage enterprise accounts. Action items: DS to prototype KIE (ETA 3 weeks), Eng to stub routing hook (ETA 4 weeks), DX to provide console mockups (ETA 2 weeks).
notes: Pilot constraints: start with hosted API customers before private/VPC due to enrichment data availability.
Risk: over-automation could misroute high-risk tuning requests. Mitigation: conservative thresholds and manual override in early rollout.
Long-term: feed realized outcomes back into KIE to transition from heuristic simulations to learned estimators.
